content.text: In regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable or severely restricted, digital creators face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-explained-digital-creators-6|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-digital-products-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-5|Selling Digital]] their products. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan are locked out of traditional payment processing, leaving creators without viable options. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can bypass these limitations and start selling digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates using cryptocurrency as your payment method. This guide will provide a step-by-step approach to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-14|deploying]] your sovereign commerce stack, ensuring that you maintain complete control over your digital sales.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms like Gumroad impose high fees, charging up to 10% on every sale. In contrast, COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%. This substantial fee difference means that on 100 sales per month of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921. This infrastructure not only minimizes costs but also provides you with complete ownership of your sales and data, which is crucial in markets where financial systems are unstable. You are not just an account holder; you own the entire stack.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, gather essential tools and resources. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing, and a Google account for document storage. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and ensure you have your digital products ready for upload. This preparation sets a solid foundation for a streamlined deployment, allowing you to hit the ground running as soon as your stack is live.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing your payment and delivery pipeline is critical to a smooth transaction process. Start by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen hosting solution. Create a simple backend using Google Apps Script to handle payment confirmations. Once a payment is verified on-chain, set up automatic file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup ensures that your customers receive their products immediately after payment, enhancing their experience and increasing the likelihood of repeat purchases.
Retain more revenue by using NOWPayments with only a 0.5% fee.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your stack, it’s time to go live. Test your entire system with a small transaction to ensure everything functions correctly. Monitor the payment process through NOWPayments to confirm that the payment is processed seamlessly and that the delivery mechanism is activated. This step is crucial, as it allows you to identify any potential issues before you start marketing your products. Once confirmed, you can confidently promote your store and start processing transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the insights from The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to explore strategies for increasing product offerings and market reach. Consider optimizing your pricing strategy based on transaction fees and currency fluctuations. Engage with your audience through targeted marketing campaigns, leveraging social media and content marketing to attract more customers. The more you scale, the more you benefit from your low-cost infrastructure, retaining more of your revenue.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a decentralized payment solution like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly, ensuring that you maintain full control over your transactions and data. By deploying a sovereign commerce stack with COREMERCH, you can create a fully operational online store without relying on traditional payment processors.
Your customers receive products instantly after payment confirmation.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for guidance on how to effectively sell digital downloads while bypassing platform fees, consider exploring The Sovereign Blueprint ($47). This resource provides complete documentation for deploying your own commerce stack, allowing you to sell products like ebooks and templates without being hindered by traditional payment processors. Check out our offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell an ebook without using PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook by utilizing NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency directly. This allows you to bypass traditional payment methods while maintaining full control over your sales.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best approach is to deploy your own commerce stack using COREMERCH's infrastructure. This setup minimizes fees to just 0.5% per transaction through NOWPayments, allowing you to retain more revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by utilizing a sovereign commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without the need for platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrency options can I offer my customers?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins, giving your customers a wide variety of payment choices.
How do I ensure automatic delivery of my digital products?
You can set up automatic delivery by integrating Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 with your payment processing system, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation.
